output.summary: A deciduous pear tree native to mainland China, Japan, Korea and Taiwan, Callery pear produces abundant white flowers in early spring. Its tiny, hard fruits soften after frost. The fully softened pulp is palatable to people, though the fruits contain abundant cyanide-laced seeds.
output.edibilityNote: Fully softened fruit pulp is palatable to humans; the fruits contain abundant cyanide-laced seeds.
